items.markdown:
The best time to visit Koh Samui is between **December and April** , featuring low rainfall, clear skies, and comfortable sea temperatures ideal for beach trips and swimming.[](https://www.tui.co.uk/holidays/weather/asia/thailand/thailand/koh-samui.html) [[1]](https://www.tui.co.uk/holidays/weather/asia/thailand/thailand/koh-samui.html)[[2]](https://www.trailfinders.com/blogs/best-time-to-visit-koh-samui)

Dry and Sunny Season (January to April)

- **Best Months:** February and March are the sweet spot, offering minimal rain, low humidity, and calm seas.
- **Atmosphere:** Peak tourist season with high-energy vibes, lively beaches, and festivities like Songkran in April.
- **Considerations:** Accommodation and flights book up quickly and cost more during these months.[](https://www.thekohsamuiguide.com/post/koh-samui-best-time) [[1]](https://www.thekohsamuiguide.com/post/koh-samui-best-time)[[2]](https://www.silavadeeresort.com/best-time-to-visit-koh-samui)

Shoulder and Hot Season (May to August)

- **Weather:** Warm and sunny with temperatures climbing above 32°C (90°F), occasionally interrupted by short, refreshing tropical showers.
- **Atmosphere:** Quieter in May and June with fewer crowds, followed by a busier family-oriented influx in July and August during European school holidays.
- **Considerations:** Great balance of lower prices and manageable weather compared to western Thai coast monsoons.[](https://www.kuoni.co.uk/destinations/south-east-asia/thailand/koh-samui/best-time-to-visit/) [[1]](https://www.kuoni.co.uk/destinations/south-east-asia/thailand/koh-samui/best-time-to-visit/)[[2]](https://www.kimptonkitalaysamui.com/best-times-to-visit-koh-samui/)

Rainy Monsoon Season (October to December)

- **Weather:** Heavy tropical downpours and rough seas, with November standing out as the wettest month.
- **Atmosphere:** Very quiet, relaxed, and slow-paced.
- **Considerations:** High risk of disruptions to boat tours and beach days, though resort and spa prices drop to their lowest.[](https://www.trailfinders.com/blogs/best-time-to-visit-koh-samui) [[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DOAgC-Tiu8K/?hl=en)
